title: Link helper regressions: busy retry loop and missing-report false success
body:
Two independent regressions in the link-validation helpers can mask errors or hammer an unavailable host:

1. `scripts/recheck_broken_links.py`: in `recheck_unanswered`, the first-round delay is skipped whenever `pending` contains one URL. A single connection-reset URL is retried continuously without calling `time.sleep`. Reproduce with `fetch` returning `OSError('connection reset')` once and HTTP 200 next, `initial_wait_ms=1`, and a mocked `time.sleep`; assert it was called once with 0.001. It is currently called zero times. Multiple URLs can also collapse to the same condition later. Track an explicit `first_round` boolean, then apply bounded backoff on every subsequent round.

2. `scripts/check_web_archive.py`: set `LYCHEE_OUTPUT` to a nonexistent report path and `GITHUB_OUTPUT` to a temporary file, then invoke `main()`. It returns success and writes `all_archived=true`, although no report was examined. Return nonzero and `all_archived=false` when the expected report is absent; distinguish a valid empty-error report from a missing artifact.

The minimal automated regressions and corrected adapted helpers are in [Data.Doublets PR 526](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/pull/526), `experiments/test_link_retries.py`. Workaround: use those corrected helpers, preserve a finite retry budget, and fail live broken links even when an archive copy exists. The reviewed upstream revision is 7ac75134c697e9468f1242c20f1d229594decbc3.

title: Retain all queued main writers with queue: max and pin actions
body:
Found while comparing the entire template tree for linksplatform/Data.Doublets#524 / https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/pull/526.

At 7ac75134c697e9468f1242c20f1d229594decbc3, `.github/workflows/release.yml` correctly uses job-level concurrency but its comment explicitly assumes that at most one pending writer is retained. The writer groups omit GitHub's new `queue: max`. Consequently a third main run replaces a second pending writer, dropping a queued release. This is observable without publishing: have the first writer wait, then push two more independent changesets and inspect the cancellation of the second run.

Suggested fix: all repository/main writers should share one group, `cancel-in-progress: false`, and `queue: max`; read-only jobs should retain distinct groups. Keep bounded non-fast-forward handling and never force push. The public documentation is https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/write-workflows/choose-when-workflows-run/control-workflow-concurrency .

Additionally workflows use mutable action tags such as `actions/checkout@v7`. Enumerate every remote `uses:` and pin it to a reviewed full commit SHA; configure Dependabot for updates. Reproduction: a check requiring `uses: owner/name@[0-9a-f]{40}` fails on the current workflow tree.

Workaround: override concurrency and action pins in consuming repositories, as in PR #526. actionlint 1.7.12 needs an independently validated workaround for the new queue field (existing report https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/issues/657); do not disable unrelated lint checks.

body:
Bumps the ci-tools group in /scripts with 1 update: [gcovr](https://github.com/gcovr/gcovr). Updates `gcovr` from 8.6 to 8.7
Release notes

Sourced from gcovr's releases.

8.7

Breaking changes:

  • Jinja2 environment for HTML report is now created with undefined=StrictUndefined to raise an error if a variable is not defined in the template. (#1282, #1283)
  • Links to lines in HTML reports now use L<line> instead of a l<line>. (#1285)
  • Rename config key txt-metric (string) to txt-metrics (list of strings in TOML and multiple entries in gcovr.config). Remove the deprecated aliases -b, --txt-branches and --branches. (#1302)
  • Adjust column width of total count in text reports. (#1302)

New features and notable changes:

  • Improve HTML report:
    • Improve wrapping of the counter in the default theme. (#1236)
    • Replace meter with div elements in the default theme (like in GitHub themes). (#1236)
    • Add jinja2 rendering for CSS files. (#1252)
    • Add new HTML themes boost.green and boost.blue. (#1248, #1271)
    • Show excluded lines, branches, ... in the summary only if there are any. (#1287)
    • Remove the branches summary and columns if there are no branches in the report, e.g all branches are excluded by patterns or comments. (#1305)
    • Replace default theme with github theme which is the new default one. If the prefix github. isn't used a warning is printed which will turn into an error in a the next version. (#1313)
  • Add compare mode for JSON, text and HTML reports. (#1240, #1266)
  • Stub missing line coverage for branches in LLVM source based code coverage format. (#1245)
  • Add support for TOML files with --config (#1258)
  • Add --fail-under-condition-or-decision with --fail-under-condition and --fail-under-decision as synonyms, change the key for the configuration file. (#1293)
  • Add support for multiple metrics in one text report and add support for condition coverage. (#1302)
  • Warn if a option is used which has no effect when processing tracefiles. (#1307)
  • Add options to restrict where GCOV is executed to prevent generating temporary files in arbitrary directories. Write protected files are now skipped by default. (#1311)

Bug fixes and small improvements:

  • Fix runtime problem introduced with 8.4. (#1270)
  • Fix boost HTML details and simple output. (#1274)
  • Fix boost HTML support for Conditions, Decisions and Calls optional stats. (#1277)
  • Add excluded metrics to boost HTML template (#1280)
  • Fix alignment in summary header of HTML single page report. (#1284)
  • Fix link to lines in HTML single page report. (#1285)
  • Preserve coverage for procedures declared in Fortran modules. (#1288)
  • Fix missing branches and conditions for uncovered lines in HTML report. (#1290)
  • Fix KeyError when merging tracefiles in which only some report a function position. (#1297)

Documentation:

  • Add section about gcov options which should not be used to FAQ. (#1237)
  • Add separate option groups for each format. (#1304)
